about_the_game:
Pretty Fly 

Bored with driving on the ground? Tired of following roads just to get from A to B?  
Oh, if only there were a way to skip those boring solid paths on land... Boats? HELL NO! AIRPLANES? HELL YES! 

Introducing our newest DLC, Pretty Fly,  an expansion that’s all about aircraft and high-flying  aerial hijinks! You can now build and pilot a wide variety of aircraft! 

 

New Building Blocks 

To help you construct the airplane of your dreams, we've added a range of new building blocks to the game. 

Use the all-new Radial Engine, specially designed for aircraft, and equip your plane with propellers, turbines, wings, and flaps to glide and maneuver through the skies with precision. 

 

New Challenges 

A new Monarch has arrived, offering you a variety of thrilling flying challenges. Fly from point A to B at high speed or showcase your skills with intricate aerial maneuvers. You better pick the right type of airplane to master all the new challenges in aviation. 

 

New Island 

Your airplanes need space to shine, so we’ve added a massive new island featuring multiple airports to take off from and land at. Soar over mountains, rivers, and even floating islands in the sky as you perform the Prettiest Fly!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: 3.1 GHz quad-core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 980
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 18 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: 3.2 GHz quad-core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 18 GB available space

short_description: Let's take off and lift your vehicle into the sky with the new "Pretty Fly" DLC for Screw Drivers! With a variety of fancy new airplane-building blocks, you can create your very own aircraft, soar over a stunning new island, and master a whole host of exciting flying challenges.
